name: mojulo
description: The mojulo plugin, published by Franz Ombico from the zombico/mojulo repository: a local MCP server that turns Claude into a game studio.

plugins.name: mojulo
plugins.description: Turn Claude into a game studio: you direct, Claude builds the levels, the cast, the feel, the look and the sound as small recipes on your machine, played in the browser, handed to a team's Godot, Unity, Unreal or Blender, and exported to glTF or STL/3MF. No account, no external telemetry.
